name: cli-dispatch
description: Delegate tasks to a DeepSeek worker CLI from inside Claude Code. DeepSeek-only fork of rbinar/cli-dispatch — the Antigravity/Gemini, Codex/OpenAI, OpenCode/OpenRouter and GitHub Copilot backends have been removed so the delegation surface names DeepSeek only. Wraps DeepSeek-powered Claude Code (claude-ds, ds-agent) with a deterministic runner (cli-dispatch-run — worker + verify, zero LLM babysitter tokens), session tracking (live monitoring + resume), runtime/idle timeout safety net, and fully-agentic tasks in isolated git worktrees.
